title: lobelia flexuosa subsp. intermedia
intro: Lobelia flexuosa subsp. intermedia, commonly known as Lobelia, is a plant species within the Lobelia genus that belongs to the Campanulaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include relieving respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma, as well as lowering blood pressure and improving circulation. The therapeutic actions of Lobelia include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and vasodilator properties, which contribute to its ability to soothe respiratory tract irritations and promote cardiovascular health. The bioactive constituents of Lobelia include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, such as lobeline, lobelanine, and lobelidine, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
